store.description: Sets whether output of the solver should be stored. Default is 'true'.

spin_sym.description: Decides on spin symmetry. Default is 'true'.

ph_sym.description: Flag for particle-hole symmetry. Default is 'true'.

use_potthoff_band_shift.description: Enables the Potthoff-Wegner-Nolting (PRB 55, 16132) m=3 moment band-shift correction to the IPT self-energy. Default is 'false', which reproduces the plain KK-IPT-n0 scheme.

band_shift_inner_maxiter.description: Maximum number of inner fixed-point iterations used to determine the interacting band shift B_tilde when 'use_potthoff_band_shift' is true. Default is 30.

band_shift_mixing.description: Linear mixing parameter in (0, 1] for the inner B_tilde fixed-point iteration. Default is 0.5.

band_shift_tol.description: Convergence tolerance (max |dB_tilde|) for the inner B_tilde fixed-point iteration. Default is 1e-8.

impurity_onsite_e.description: On-site energy of the impurity. If 'ph_sym' is set to 'true' this is set automatically.

Delta_R_im.description: Imaginary part of retarded component of the hybridisation function for each flavor.

Delta_K_im.description: Imaginary part of Keldysh component of the hybridisation function for each flavor.

T.description: Physical temperature, used to evaluate the Fermi functions of the leads for both the flat-DOS and Lorentzian hybridizations. Not needed when the hybridization is given directly via 'Delta_R_im'/'Delta_K_im'.

T_fict.description: Fictitious inverse temperature for constructing the flat DOS.

D_l.description: Half-bandwidth of the left lead contributing to the hybridization.

D_r.description: Half-bandwidth of the right lead contributing to the hybridizations.

t_l.description: Hopping amplitude between the left lead and the impurity.

t_r.description: Hopping amplitude between the right lead and the impurity.

mu.description: Chemical potential of bath hybridization function.

V.description: Applied voltage bias between the leads.

Delta_center.description: Center(s) of the Lorentzian hybridization. A single number gives a spin-symmetric (degenerate) hybridization shared by both flavors; a per-flavor object (e.g. {'up': 1.0, 'down': -1.0}) gives a spin-dependent one.

Delta_gamma.description: Width(s) of the Lorentzian hybridization, same single-number-vs-per-flavor-object convention as 'Delta_center'.

output_dir.description: Directory in which the results are stored.
